# SkyCo

> SkyCo is a founder-led software studio building small web tools for everyday life. Three products are live today: a currency converter, a multi-calendar app, and a chat-based portfolio tracker.

SkyCo is the parent company for a family of focused, no-clutter web tools. Each product lives on its own site and links back here.

## Pages

- [Home](https://skyco.online/): Overview of SkyCo, its live products, how the company works, and how to get in touch.

## Projects

- [CurrenSee](https://currensee.skyco.online/): Live fiat and crypto conversion, rate charts, and price alerts.
- [Chronos (Celestial Timekeeper)](https://chronos.skyco.online/): Gregorian, Hijri, Hebrew, Chinese and Persian calendars side by side, with scheduling.
- [My Finance Friend](https://chat-folio-pilot.lovable.app/): Track stocks and ETFs by chatting in plain English, with a preview before anything saves.
